impact.reason: 2.8.0 (26 October 2026), #401: the maintainer requested autonomous implementation, native verification, signed/notarized direct distribution and production delivery of four core utilities, experimental Snap & Talk and separate Meetings. Candidate acceptance covers the exact-edition signed upgrade and saved-work smoke, Snap capture/copy/export/cancel, the scoped Meetings retirement and experimental opt-in lifecycle, and four-tool navigation. Real iPhone/USB/Continuity Camera, named call receivers, minimum macOS, fresh-account permissions, complete Snap & Talk assistant output and long two-sided Meetings capture retain their hardware/account limits in #7 and the separate Meetings verification record. Public download and feed delivery are observed only after publication.
